svg.title: OpenCode Go pace sidebar with a bold title and behind-pace, ahead-of-pace, and critical monthly bars
svg.desc: Terminal-style screenshot of the OpenCode Go sidebar in pace mode, captured from a 64 by 5 character frame rendered with fake usage data. The 4 visible rows read: OpenCode Go 5-hour ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━───────── 25% Weekly ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━── 95% Monthly ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━100%
